summary.text: Mike Noack, a Republican truck driver from Bonfield, Illinois, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the open U.S. House seat in Illinois's 2nd District to Donna Miller.
On his campaign website he describes himself as "a trucker, not a politician".

paragraphs.text: Noack was born in Bonfield, Illinois, according to Ballotpedia, and says on his campaign website that he has lived in Kankakee County for 32 years.

He works as a truck driver; his campaign website says he holds a commercial driver's license (CDL) and has driven on highways in the district and across the country. He says his wife is from Japan, which he cites as the reason legal immigration is a personal issue for him.
Noack was the only Republican in the March 17, 2026 primary for the open seat and advanced to the November general election.
His campaign website listed healthcare costs, energy and fiscal responsibility among his issues.
He received 26.8% of the vote to Donna Miller's 73.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Donna Miller pitches health care record, local roots in 2nd District primary
